name: game-design
description: Game design in two modes: an existing headless pipeline for generative design, and one-page-game-design for collaborative discovery and walkthroughs. The collaborative workflow produces light interactive HTML or a detailed standalone SVG, a one-page PDF, and a saved design record. Existing deep-design skills cover systems, progression, levels, UX, and prototyping. Designs go to game:game-studio-cpo for critique.
